trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no extra task behind it, no online mode and no DLC requirement, so the whole hunt is the other 54 trophies. PowerPyx puts the full run at roughly 200 hours and a 4 out of 10 difficulty.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; it pops as the chapter closes and the next chapter begins. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as the chapter closes. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops as the chapter closes. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops as the chapter closes. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy. Complete the final mission and the trophy pops as the story ends and the credits roll. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Gold. After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist. It is far kinder than it sounds: PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion, with only 70 of 80 challenges needed, 200 of 277 vehicles to scan and 100 of 255 animals to study. Nothing on the list can be missed, so clean it up in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories; the under-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress, Activities, Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress, Activities to see which you still owe; the map's Activities filter marks them. Most come naturally while chasing other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold medals are not punishing, and the ranges unlock as you explore Leonida. PowerPyx lists all 12 range locations.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations, 42 races in total. You only need one win per location, so pick the easiest race at each spot. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations. Each race counts once, so spread out across the map rather than replaying one favourite. PowerPyx lists all 40 race locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around Leonida. You must reach the end of the game, not beat every challenge in it. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 Andy calls Lucia and texts her address in Belville. Finish her five missions, the Cellerica chain, and the trophy pops at the last one. All of her quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving line starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams; he calls, then waits at the green KR icon in Key Lento. Dive seven shipwrecks, bring the treasure back, and keep answering his calls for the next set. He goes quiet for a while in Chapter 1 but returns later; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 hurries him along.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's line opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five missions, ending with Hometown Heroes. All of his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain strangers count: PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. All of the strangers stay available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars; deliver each to his garage in west Vice City, in good condition for a better payout. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers point at synthetic labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest and Tyrone hands you Spin On This, the finale. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. THE missable one: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept her meditation lesson. That home meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped, so do it to be safe. Track progress in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia cannot get it). Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him; his first quest hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle. Which animal exactly pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so work through his Target Decks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets from the 18 sets hidden around Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt; PowerPyx maps all 18 sets, so pick the three easiest to finish first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK points: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. Hold Up on the D-pad to open the WAiNK app, then hold R1 on a point to scan it. There are far more than 100, so any hundred will do.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them in Progress, Challenges and pick the easiest ones left; most complete naturally while working on other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape it. You can only do this after Coffee Break (Chapter 2) unlocks free-roaming together; call your partner with Right plus Triangle. PowerPyx's easy escape: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the big bank vault robberies.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level: keep the flashing wanted level alive the whole run. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) unlocks them; loot a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan passing traffic: scanning is enough, you never need to drive them. Leonida has 557 vehicles; the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so this comes first.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming). It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so buff focus first with food, drink, a wash or Adrenaline, wear body armour, and line up five gang-operation enemies with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians. Focus reaches level 4 naturally as you play.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA: the ones on the open airfield do not count. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge, board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive in through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and fire at enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to get the Snap Gun. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good pick.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner (hold Right). After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip. There are 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist wants all 8. Each robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike, then switch cars.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission as the bank vaults: tailing the truck to the bank counts. Earlier method: block a truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it, then escape the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them; track each gang in Progress, Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing by the bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS first. Any other car will not do: it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). It pops after you escape the police, and you do not need all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so come back for what you missed.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Buy a fitness club membership, always work out together (call your partner with Right plus Triangle) so the idle character trains too, and check strength in Touchpad, Jason and Lucia. You can only switch characters after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on the notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon. Robberies, clean escapes and stealth count as Professional; killing pushes you toward Violent and Psycho. It accrues passively through every other trophy; if it is your last one, keep robbing and fighting.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Not yet solved. PowerPyx lists this one as currently unknown and believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description, Second time's the charm, hints at retrying something. No source has confirmed the method yet, so do not chase it until a guide pins it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A UFO easter egg. Go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2 AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return. Follow the path into the woods from the car, approach the UFO's blue light, and it drops an abducted woman: talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet solved. PowerPyx lists this one as currently unknown and believes it comes from kicking people while driving a motorcycle: a melee drive-by. No source has confirmed the exact move yet, so treat any method as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays best. The total accrues across robberies; bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one hit.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so Ammu-Nation, mod shops and tattoo studios drain the total fastest. It counts across every shop type, so it accrues while you play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more come from the story and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 are the quickest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register. Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
